prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: The **women’s 800-meter freestyle**. Before 2024, Ledecky had lowered her own world record **four times** in the event—second only to her five improvements in the 1,500-meter freestyle.
